founders.name: Mario Bustamante
founders.bio: As an electronics engineer with 10+ years of experience, I developed personalized IoT devices selling 11,000+ units which led to my first exit. I sold my first startup to one of the top retailers in LATAM. Inspired by my girlfriend, a farmer and agronomist, I became passionate about helping farmers make better decisions. Today, with Instacrops, we are operating in 350+ farms wondering how to improve the food production with Software and AI reducing food security risks

name: Micro Meat
description: Technologies for scaling up cultured/clean meat production

founders.name: Anne-Sophie Mertgen
founders.bio: I am a biomedical engineer (with PhD from ETH Zurich) passionate about saving our planet and animal welfare. That is why I decided to focus my career towards cultivated meat and why I started Micro Meat in 2021 and now Pythag Tech.

founders.name: Vincent Pribble
founders.bio: Launched rockets at ULA. Built New Glenn at Blue Origin. Founded through Y Combinator. Now leading rad-hard microelectronics at Mercury Systems.

name: Alga Biosciences
description: We stop cows from burping methane.

founders.name: Alexander Brown
founders.bio: Alex studied life sciences and economics in undergrad, but worked as a Chief of Staff at a software company until he couldn’t stop thinking about how annoying it was that nobody had solved the problem of cow burps yet.

founders.name: Daria Balatsky
founders.bio: Daria is a physical chemist who has worked on various topics from synthesizing drugs for kidney disease to studying quantum materials as a PhD candidate. Now she applies herself as a co-founder and chemist for Alga Biosciences.

founders.name: Caroline McKeon
founders.bio: Physical chemist training and trained in quantum mechanical electronic structure theory at the University of California, Berkeley (CA) and Haverford College (PA). Creating cattle feed additives to reduce methane emissions by ruminants. Bring kelp to cows, bring science to application!

name: Hedgehog
description: Building robotic mushroom farms

founders.name: Jamie Balsillie
founders.bio: Jamie is a co-founder of Hedgehog, building robotic mushroom farms. He previously founded Indigo Carbon, the largest agriculture carbon credit platform. He joined Indigo Agriculture pre-revenue and helped scale sales to >$250m as GM of two new business units. Before Indigo, he worked in software and food at McKinsey & Co. In June 2022, Jamie graduated from Stanford's MBA.

founders.name: Wilson Ruotolo
founders.bio: Wilson Ruotolo is a co-founder of Hedgehog, where he designs robotics for mushroom production. He received his PhD from Stanford, studying the design of robotic hands. He collaborated with NASA on end-effectors for martian exploration and his prototypes have been used to retrieve artifacts off the Mediterranean seafloor. He has first author publications in multiple journals, including Science Robotics, and his work is featured in TechCrunch, Popular Science, and Spotify’s Soft Robotics podcast.

name: Ohmic Biosciences
description: Genetically engineering plants for disease resistance.

founders.name: PJ Steiner
founders.bio: I'm a protein engineer, synthetic biologist, and computer scientist. I studied computer science at MIT (SB/MEng) and then synthetic biology at Cambridge (PhD) and UCSD (postdoc). After two years as a scientist at Bolt Threads engineering yeast for protein production, I moved to the University of Colorado Boulder to work on a DARPA project using protein engineering to turn plants into chemical biosensors. My co-founder Matt and I founded Ohmic to make plants resistant to disease.

founders.name: Matthew Bedewitz
founders.bio: I'm a plant biochemist with experience in protein engineering, genetics and analytical chemistry. I studied Horticulture Science (BS), and then Plant Breeding, Genetics, and Biotechnology (PhD) at Michigan State where I characterized enzymes in tropane alkaloid production for nerve agent antidotes and stimulants (including cocaine). That work led me to a DARPA protein engineering project where I met my cofounder, PJ, and we decided to use our skills to tackle crop disease resistance.

name: Feanix Biotechnologies
description: Farm Genetics Made Easy - Using DNA and Software

founders.name: Mitchell Angove
founders.bio: Hi, I am Mitch and I am a Co-Founder of Feanix Biotechnologies. At Feanix we focus on utilizing DNA to create a new generation of efficient and healthy agriculture. I grew up on a farm and have spent a lifetime in agriculture working to make a better future of food. I have a Bachelors in Genetics and a Masters in Animal Science.

founders.name: Tom Bishop
founders.bio: Co-founder and CSO of Feanix Biotechnologies. Completed a BSc with honors in Biochemistry and PhD in Genetics at the University of Otago in New Zealand. Was a Postdoctoral Scholar in the department of Animal Science at UC Davis for five years. Research highlights include developing a chemical treatment to improve regeneration of non-regenerative tissues, developing a transgene to differentiate between X and Y chromosome sperm, and developing a new method for transgene delivery to avian embryos.

name: Precip
description: High precision AI weather

founders.name: Jesse Vollmar
founders.bio: Previously CEO of FarmLogs (YC W12) where we built the most popular farm management software in the US and raised $37m from top investors like Sam Altman and Drive Capital. Currently building Precip (YC W24). We measure rain without needing gauges.

founders.name: Michael Asher
founders.bio: Data scientist and software engineer. Fascinated by agriculture and construction.

name: ACX
description: Next-generation biocides for sustainable agriculture at scale

founders.name: Emmanouela Petsolari
founders.bio: Emmanouela is the Co-Founder & CEO of ACX and PhD in Biochemistry and Biophysics from the University of Cambridge. Previously, she held several research positions working in immunology, cancer, malaria vaccine development and viral drug discovery (in institutes like Barts Cancer Institute CRUK, Cambridge University, King’s College London, Institute Curie France and Imperial College London).

founders.name: Melina Petsolari
founders.bio: Melina is the Co-founder & CTO of ACX and PhD in Computer Science from King's College London. Previously, she held several research positions spanning digital health, robotics, technology-enable interventions, HCAI and NLP (in institutes like Cambridge University, King’s College London, National Health Service (NHS) in England and Francis Crick Institute).

name: Silurian
description: Foundation models to simulate Earth, starting with weather.

founders.name: Jayesh K. Gupta
founders.bio: Jayesh is Co-founder and CEO of Silurian AI. Previously he was the Head of AI at Poly Corporation. He led the development of the first foundation model for weather & climate as researcher at Microsoft and was the co-author of Aurora. Jayesh holds a Ph.D. in CS from Stanford.

name: Red Barn Robotics
description: A Roomba for weeds on a farm.

founders.name: Adam Iseman
founders.bio: I'm the CEO of Red Barn Robotics where we are building an autonomous weeding robot to help healthily feed the world.

founders.name: Ilya Kelner
founders.bio: CTO/cofounder at Red Barn Robotics. Previously worked on: Flight software and testing architecture @ Relativity Space - Flight software lead. Built: triple string fault tolerant flight computer architecture, Dockerized flight software deployments, CI/CD for HOOTL, HITL, VITL. Autonomous cars @ Nvidia. Starlink @ SpaceX. Xbox @ Microsoft. Early employee at 2 other startups in the past.

founders.name: Alex Neff
founders.bio: Co-founder and COO of Red Barn Robotics, building an autonomous weeding robot to help healthily feed the world. Previously Senior Product Manager at Amazon where I led the development of new ML based search algorithms.

founders.name: Zarif Azher
founders.bio: Previously built medical devices, biosensors, and AI for healthcare. Now building microchips for cattle monitoring!

founders.name: Kenneth Chan
founders.bio: Prev @ Caltech. Now building the future of livestock health monitoring.

founders.name: Sam Rogers
founders.bio: CEO of Brumby. Spent half my life on a cattle farm, and the other half building robots.

name: Molagri
description: Resistance free pesticides.

founders.name: Zaky Hassan
founders.bio: Zaky is a protein biochemist and viral structural biologist who has characterized mechanisms of antibody neutralization in human pathogenic coronaviruses. He has an undergraduate degree in Biochemistry (Honours BSc) and graduate training in Biochemistry (PhD candidate) from the University of Toronto. He was awarded $130K+ in fellowships, and published twice in Nature Communications. Zaky previously founded a non-profit, raised $1M+ in grants and operated programming for 1000+ youth in Toronto.

founders.name: Min Jin
founders.bio: Min is a viral structural biologist and protein biochemist, and the current world record holder for the highest resolution structure of a coronavirus spike protein in the Protein Data Bank (1.68 Å). She has an undergraduate degree in Biophysics (Honours BSc) and graduate training in Biochemistry (PhD candidate) from the University of Toronto and she has published in Nature Microbiology and Nature Communications.

name: Nitroduck
description: Monsanto for yummy crops, but without pesticides

founders.name: Matej Zamecnik
founders.bio: Co-founder & CEO at Nitroduck (YC F26). Led 21 students to the Grand Prize at iGEM, the world's biggest biotech competition, by making duckweed, the fastest-growing plant on Earth, programmable. Before that, he co-founded Spicy Cells, building bioreactors to grow saffron as plant cell cultures. Researched at CEITEC. MS in Plant Experimental Biology, Masaryk University.

founders.name: Matúš Grieš
founders.bio: Co-founder & CTO at Nitroduck (YC F26). I co-led iGEM Brno 2025 to Grand Prize against 330 teams including Stanford and Oxford. I worked at Karolinska Institutet (Amgen Scholars), building nanoparticles for drug delivery to placenta and at CEITEC, where I demonstrated plant telomere proteins bind human DNA more tightly than their own. I'm a National Decathlon Champion and 13x silver medalist in triple jump and high jump.

founders.name: Miro Rosputinský
founders.bio: Co-founder & CSO at Nitroduck. Won the iGEM Grand Prize against 330 teams. Research fellow at Weizmann Institute (<1% acceptance) where I engineered cotton to produce spider silk proteins and potatoes to make barnacle adhesive. Built the first metabolic model of a bioplastic-producing bacterium.

name: Lux Foods
description: Crops engineered for premium fruit, grown without sunlight.

founders.name: Andre Yeung
founders.bio: CEO & co-founder at Lux Foods. Stanford BioE/Computer Science (AI) B.S./B.S.. First lab student in Dr. Robert Jinkerson's lab at UC Riverside, leading project on endosymbiotic gene transfer in algae. Previously student researcher at Brophy Lab working on synthetic genetic circuits in plants. Founded Fruit for Homeless nonprofit, leading 25 students to rescue and distribute 300,000 pounds of fresh fruit to underserved LA communities. Regeneron STS Semi-finalist, iGEM silver medalist.

founders.name: Robert Jinkerson
founders.bio: Co-founder & CSO at Lux Foods. Professor of Chemical Engineering at UC Riverside since 2017, engineering crops for controlled environments and space. Led the UCR team that won NASA's Deep Space Food Challenge and flew cherry tomatoes to the ISS. NSF CAREER Award, FFAR New Innovator Award. Showed plants can grow on acetate without sunlight (Nature Food 2022). Previously postdoc at Stanford; PhD, Colorado School of Mines.
